status: Implemented and verified; P3-T7, P3-T8 and Phase 3 user acceptance remain pending

tests.note: One final full-suite run on the unchanged source/test manifest; no failures, errors or skips. Earlier focused runs are not added to this total.

implemented: Read-only JSON workflow-report for success, failure, interruption, permission failure, unverified proof, replanning and superseded histories
Delivered files with exact contributing patches/Tasks, current and final validation, unresolved findings/feedback, manual/reuse status and actual evidence paths
Exact original feedback and idempotent routing/outcome history; a same-scope defect consumes the existing Task correction allowance without resetting approval or records
After an earlier Task correction, revalidate and independently review previously completed later Tasks; run all final checks again
Changed requirements invalidate the old planning/execution route; atomically preserve/supersede the workflow and register fresh current-file planning with no approval
Replanning baselines for generated source/tests use standard-user AppContainer and named-Job/PID checks without host execution fallback
Explicit user reuse explanations refer to actual passing final-validation IDs for every current reused requirement, including requirements with no Task
Required manual definitions are pinned before execution approval; actual observations are versioned against plan, policy, code and final-completion identity
Explicit workflow-accept only after complete task/review order, all final checks, intact evidence, no mandatory unresolved work, and current reuse/manual confirmation
Separate result-acceptance authorization and measured waiting intervals; technical completion remains distinct from user acceptance

verification.reports: Actual isolated success/failure, correction exhaustion, permission failure, forced-controller interruption and partial patches; reports preserve DB bytes, events, project files, calls and approvals.
verification.feedback: Exact multiline text, stable replay IDs, unchanged approval/attempt history, correction exhaustion, code-versus-environment routing and fresh independent review before marking corrected.
verification.same_content_correction: A new final-validation batch invalidates old manual confirmation even when application bytes are unchanged. Downstream Tasks receive validation/review without duplicate Developer calls.
verification.replanning: New current-file baseline and unapproved planning; atomic rollback on insertion/event failure and real os._exit(77), no ownership loss, idempotent linked replacement and no old-approval bypass.
verification.isolated_replanning: Actual AppContainer baseline retains baseline-validation identity, input hash and zero-capability non-elevated token. Permission failures, failed checks and interruption block baseline credit and Planner dispatch without host fallback.
verification.reuse_and_manual: No-Task reused requirements; missing, failed and stale evidence; baseline/non-final IDs rejected; every declared manual check remains mandatory.
verification.acceptance: Precompletion, user edits, edits during final-evidence inspection, missing/modified final records/JUnit/log/Reviewer responses, failed or substituted final batches and unresolved mandatory findings block acceptance.
verification.acceptance_binding: Final evidence follows every role attempt, is latest for its registered check, matches the durable technical-completion event and AppContainer token, and retains sealed artifacts. Repeat acceptance is idempotent.
verification.legacy: Historical runs lack the newly approved result policy/seals and cannot be silently accepted or upgraded.
verification.ai_transport: Tests use deterministic local role subprocesses, not new AI-service calls. Generated application checks execute in actual AppContainer. Test-fixture acceptance is not user acceptance of this Phase.

integration_fixes: Existing Store initialization no longer rewrites the SQLite user-version header when merely opening an existing journal; missing schemas are not silently rebuilt.
Final validation IDs must match the technical-completion event and follow all role attempts, preventing reuse of an earlier same-content Task check.
Final file identity is checked again after evidence inspection to preserve an edit made during acceptance verification.
Requirements replanning keeps generated tests in AppContainer instead of using the original host baseline validator.
The T5 final-timeout regression now distinguishes preserved execution-approval wait from the newly introduced result-acceptance wait.

acceptance_blockers: Legacy results lack approved acceptance policy and sealed evidence; prepare a new approved workflow.
historical_live_report_inspection.note: This reads the existing two-call T5 live result. Its expected unverified report and blocked acceptance prove the new legacy/reuse guards without changing historical evidence or making a new live call.

remaining_work: P3-T7 actual external end-to-end example with genuine user result acceptance
P3-T8 fixed-runner isolation and promotion proof
Phase4 compact report presentation and dogfooding
limits: Reports currently use JSON CLI output; compact human-oriented report presentation remains Phase4.
Reuse explanations and manual observations are explicit user attestations tied to controller-recorded final tests; they are not inferred from a generic passing baseline.
Changed requirements must be reflected in the registered specification before new planning captures current files; feedback does not silently rewrite the specification.
Manual-check definitions cannot be added or weakened after execution approval; changing them requires a new approved execution policy.
Historical T4/T5 completed results remain inspectable, but acceptance requires a new approved result_version=1 workflow with sealed final evidence.
Accepted, cancelled and superseded results cannot be reopened through the same-scope feedback route; exhausted correction allowances are not reset.
No actual Phase3 user acceptance, T7 completion, fixed runner A, administrator setup, commit or push is claimed.
